messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick weekly check-in for BlueOak — focused on error-rate breakdown and top failing endpoints 
Maya (CSM): TL;DR — overall error rate rose from 1.8% -> 3.6% week-over-week. Biggest contributors: 5xx spikes during nightly batch window, intermittent timeouts on embeddings, and a small burst of rate_limit responses on streaming chat routes. 
Maya (CSM): Key numbers: total requests 1.2M, errors 43.2k (3.6%), 5xx ~ 26.8k (62% of errors), timeouts ~ 10.8k (25%), rate_limit ~ 5.6k (13%) 
Maya (CSM): Top failing endpoints (by error count):
- /v1/generate (5xx dominant) — 18.4k errors, spike around 02:00–03:00 UTC 
- /v1/embeddings (timeouts) — 8.1k timeouts, median latency doubled during runbook jobs 
- /v1/chat/stream (rate_limit + some timeouts) — 5.6k rate_limited responses, ~800 timeouts 
- /v1/batch/submit (mixed 5xx/timeouts) — 3.9k errors, correlates with larger payloads
Maya (CSM): Customer impact notes: BlueOak reported 3 support tickets complaining about slow embeddings in onboarding flows (priority: medium). Renewal E: flagged by @Eloise — we should be proactive. 
Raj (SRE): Can you paste a sample 5xx trace and the window boundaries? I want to check autoscaler and GC cycles. 
Maya (CSM): Sure — sample 5xx from /v1/generate during spike:
```
[02:18:12 UTC] 5xx: upstream timeout (worker 7) model=optic-13b seq=512
[02:18:12 UTC] rpc: connection reset by peer
[02:18:12 UTC] kvcache: flush fallback 
```
Maya (CSM): Spike window: 01:52–03:10 UTC, peak at ~02:18 UTC. 
Raj (SRE): Looks like worker OOM/restarts or upstream connection flaps. I'll check node logs for that timeframe and weight loading patterns. Could also be longer sequences hitting memory thresholds. 
Liam (Support): Tickets reference embeddings timing out around 10:30–11:00 PT on Tues/Wed. Are those runbook jobs? 
Maya (CSM): Yes — embedding backfill ran Tuesday 10:20–11:05 PT and again Wednesday 10:15–10:50 PT. We recommended running smaller shard sizes last week but they used the full backfill. 
Eloise (AE): Renewal note: customer usage is up so renewal intent still positive, but CSAT dropped 0.2 pts this week. They asked for mitigation before renewal review. Please add a short mitigation plan we can send them. :sweat_smile: 
Raj (SRE): Proposed short-term mitigations:
- Add soft rate-limit backpressure on /v1/batch/submit during backfill windows
- Increase worker pool by +2 GPUs during off-peak autoscaler window (01:30–03:30 UTC) 
- Enable transient-kvcache retention for generate to reduce repeat compute on long sequences
Maya (CSM): OpsBot ran a quick health check: 
OpsBot (bot): "Service check — generate: degraded (latency high), embeddings: intermittent timeouts, chat/stream: rate-limited bursts" 
Liam (Support): I'll reply to the three tickets with ETA: suggesting they pause large backfills or shard them, and offering a temporary priority queue for onboarding embeddings. 
Eloise (AE): Can we get an action item list for the customer note? A one-pager with steps + expected timeline would help. 
Raj (SRE): Action items I'll own (ETA 24h):
- Collect GC and OOM logs for affected nodes (done by EOD)
- Temporarily scale workers for 01:30–03:30 UTC for next 3 nights (config change + rollout)
- Add a brief autoscaler policy tweak to cap batch-size when concurrent backfills detected
Maya (CSM): Action items I'll own:
- Draft customer note + mitigation one-pager and share with @Eloise by tomorrow morning
- Confirm which runbook shards BlueOak used and ask them to shard smaller for next runbackfill
Liam (Support): I'll add inline KB steps to ticket and offer a 1:1 troubleshooting session. 
Eloise (AE): I'll loop in the renewal committee and attach the one-pager once ready. 
Maya (CSM): Follow-ups: Raj, please post findings (logs + root cause candidate) in this thread. Ops: if we see another spike, enable the temporary scaling immediately. 
Raj (SRE): Will do. If we find worker-level OOMs, priority fix will be to backport a memory threshold guard to the runtime and roll a patch. 
Maya (CSM): Thanks all. I'll post the customer-facing blurb draft here when ready. :thumbsup: 
Eloise (AE): Thanks team — sending to BlueOak after review.
